title: Bulk Email Verifier & Validator
description: Verify a list of email addresses in bulk. Returns a deliverability verdict, catch-all, disposable, role and free-provider flags and a 0-100 quality score for every address. Priced per result, no API key needed.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Email addresses to verify. Paste a list, or map an email field from another Actor's dataset. Duplicates are removed before verification.

mode.title: Verification mode
mode.description: auto = pick per list size (bulk when > 500). realtime = one request per email, streamed. bulk = submit the whole list to the Verifox bulk API, then collect results.

concurrency.title: Concurrency (realtime mode)
concurrency.description: How many emails to verify in parallel in realtime mode (1–20). Higher is faster.
